2607.01627.title: MKGR: Multimodal Knowledge-Graph Representation Learning for Cold-Start Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
2607.01627.paper_summary: Accurate protein-protein interaction (PPI) prediction is central to functional genomics, disease mechanism discovery, and drug development. A difficult setting arises when candidate interactions include proteins that have no observed PPI edges during training, where models relying on network topology alone often lose useful context. This paper presents \method, a multimodal representation framework for cold-start PPI prediction. \method\ combines region-aware protein sequence encoding with four protein-centered biomedical knowledge graphs, including protein-drug, protein-disease, protein-miRNA, and protein-lncRNA associations. The sequence branch extracts contextual representations from structurally informed sequence regions, while graph attention encoders learn modality-specific protein embeddings from sparse biomedical associations. A bridge reconstruction objective regularizes graph learning by recovering shared protein-entity associations, and a pair-level gating module adaptively integrates sequence and graph evidence for each candidate protein pair. Experiments on two benchmark datasets under novel-old and novel-novel cold-start settings show that \method\ consistently outperforms competitive sequence, network, and knowledge-graph baselines across ACC, F1, AUC, AUPR, and MCC.
2607.01627.paper_summary_zh: 準確的蛋白質-蛋白質互動（PPI）預測對於功能基因組學、疾病機制發現和藥物開發至關重要。當候選互動包括在訓練期間沒有觀察到 PPI 邊緣的蛋白質時，會出現困難的情境，此時僅依賴網絡拓撲的模型往往會失去有用的上下文。本文提出了 \method，一種用於冷啟動 PPI 預測的多模態表示框架。 \method\ 將區域感知的蛋白質序列編碼與四個以蛋白質為中心的生物醫學知識圖譜相結合，包括蛋白質-藥物、蛋白質-疾病、蛋白質-miRNA 和蛋白質-lncRNA 相關性。序列分支從結構信息豐富的序列區域中提取上下文表示，而圖形注意編碼器則從稀疏的生物醫學關聯中學習模態特定的蛋白質嵌入。橋接重建目標通過恢復共享的蛋白質-實體關聯來正則化圖形學習，而對於每對候選蛋白質，成對級別的閘模塊自適應地整合序列和圖形證據。在新舊和新新冷啟動設置下對兩個基準數據集的實驗表明，\method\ 在 ACC、F1、AUC、AUPR 和 MCC 等指標上始終優於競爭性的序列、網絡和知識圖譜基線。
2607.01627.author: Wenbo Zhang et.al.
